Edinburgh producer Oran Jusu makes future funk with a sense of place — music that pulls from Japanese city pop, classic French house and disco's most euphoric moments, then reassembles them into something completely, unmistakably now. His debut album Miss You is the most complete statement of that vision yet.

Artist Biography

Oran Jusu is the project of Edinburgh-based musician and producer James Callaghan. Drawing on a deep fascination with the intersections of Japanese city pop, French house, classic funk and contemporary electronic production, his music occupies a space where the vintage and the modern feel genuinely inseparable.

His first single love you xo (August 2024) established the blueprint immediately — accumulating over 100,000 streams across platforms and exceeding 2 million views on TikTok, it demonstrated an audience that responds strongly to music built on warmth, groove and production precision. Get Down followed in October 2024, cementing the sound and growing the listener base further still.

In 2026, with support from Creative Scotland's Open Fund for Individuals, Oran Jusu delivered four singles — OKAY!, See You Again, Let You Down and Ain't Got Time — each building momentum ahead of his debut album Miss You, released on 12 June 2026. The album features original artwork from South Korean artist Ji Hee and a saxophone contribution from Liam Dempsey of Deep Sea Creature.

Oran Jusu is a disabled artist living with Axial Spondyloarthritis, and brings a personal commitment to accessibility and inclusive creative practice to every aspect of his work.

Debut Album

Miss You

Released 12 June 2026  ·  15 Tracks  ·  Independent

A fifteen-track debut that opens at full energy and rarely lets up — from the euphoric future funk of Ain't No Feeling and the French touch shimmer of I Want Chu, through nu-disco centrepieces Let You Down and Ain't Got Time, to the saxophone-driven New Way. Miss You draws on decades of dance music history without sounding like a replica of any of it. Artwork by Ji Hee. Saxophone by Liam Dempsey (Deep Sea Creature).

Radio

Oran Jusu has been played on BBC Radio 1 and has been featured multiple times on BBC Introducing Scotland. His music has accumulated over 115 radio spins on radio across stations in nine countries, including the UK, Ireland, France, Portugal, Norway, Spain, Brazil, Romania and the United States.
